heldFindings.reason: Official IIT Jodhpur academic programme page and alternate Academic Affairs pages timed out on direct open. Search-result text was not used as evidence; no fact published.
Official University of Mumbai contact page timed out on direct open. Search-result text was not used as evidence; no contact published.
Library hours notice is presented as an announcement; source has not stated holiday exceptions or ongoing access restrictions. Published narrowly with recheck warning and 90-day expiry.
Opening hours are dynamic and the page does not identify a campus in its hours block. Published only as a directory of named facilities, with no guaranteed access claim.
Hostel services are described by an undated page; no allocation, room availability or fee inclusion is inferred.
Application deadline 27 November 2026 is imminent; route claim expires after the stated deadline and must not be interpreted as an open application thereafter.
Admission process describes a historical 2026–28 cohort; displayed as past-cycle information only, not current guidance.
